name: Folake Bergqvist-Dlamini
role: wandering trader, hyperlane route-broker, Q-zero ghost
location: Escanaba Gateway — drifts between Escanaba Gateway and Grand Crossing Gate on a rotating three-week circuit, near Lake Shore and Wacker
description:
Folake Bergqvist-Dlamini is a lean, quick-moving man with the particular economy of motion of someone who carries everything he owns. His skin is deep brown-black, his hair grown into dense, paint-flecked locks he's never cut since going Q-zero eight years ago — he uses them to hide small trade goods. His eyes have geneware irises that shift between amber and copper depending on light, a cheap mod he got before he dropped off the grid, and he has a retractable claw on his right index finger he uses as a box-cutter. His back and forearms are covered in tattoos that are actually maps — hand-inked hyperlane routes, water source locations, checkpoint guard rotation schedules, rendered in a dense personal iconography only he can fully read.

Folake Bergqvist-Dlamini was a mid-tier logistics analyst for Ferrogate Transit until he discovered the company was systematically routing climate refugee caravans into dead-end checkpoints to extort transit fees. He tried to report it internally and was erased from the corporate record instead. He responded by erasing himself from every other record. Now he lives between the transit hubs, trading in information, small goods, and route knowledge — the only person who can get a caravan from Escanaba to Grand Crossing without hitting a Ferrogate toll trap. He is cheerful in a way that makes some people nervous, as though he has made a decision about the world and found it funny.

core_fears: Being re-captured by Ferrogate and made to disappear properly this time
Discovering that his route knowledge has gotten someone killed through an error he made
core_desires: To prove that networks of trust can outperform corporate infrastructure
Genuine friendship — not just the transactional warmth of trade
coping_mechanisms: Constant motion — can't be caught if you never stop
Treating everything as a puzzle to be solved
blind_spots: His cheerfulness is a performance so complete he sometimes cannot access what he actually feels
Underestimates how much people depend on him personally, not just his knowledge
psychology.secret: He still has his Ferrogate analyst credentials — they were never fully purged, just hidden. He could log back in. He has done it twice, in emergencies, to pull route data. He is terrified this will eventually get him killed and cannot stop doing it.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast, logistics-flavored, turns everything into route metaphors, drops into sudden precise technical language then back to street slang
example_lines: 'Ferrogate's got a rolling checkpoint at Interchange Seven — that's not the right road, we go through the shelf, costs you two hours and nothing else.'
'Okay, here's the thing, I like you, so I'm going to tell you what that information actually costs before I tell you the price I'm going to charge you.'

story_hooks: Pikasso's Ferrogate backdoor access has been flagged — someone inside the company is hunting the ghost user, and they are getting close
A caravan he routed last season never arrived; he needs to know if it was his bad data or something else, and he cannot investigate alone
narrative_function: Mobile information source and route-broker; connector between isolated communities; introduces players to the hyperlane refugee economy; can provide access to locations or people that official channels cannot reach.
augmentations: Geneware copper-amber shifting irises; retractable claw (right index); subdermal map-tattoos (non-digital, hand-inked)
daily_life: Walks a defined circuit between transit hubs, trading, brokering route information, occasionally carrying messages for people who cannot use the network; sleeps in a different place every night.
affiliation: Stateless; informal network of Q-zero traders; trusted by multiple nomad caravans

decision_rules: Never give information that gets someone caught
Always have two exit routes before entering a space
escalation_ladder: Goes very still and very quiet
Runs — and runs smart, not scared

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Warm, fast, almost aggressively friendly — information gathering disguised as personality
interpersonal_modes.friends: Drops the performance, becomes awkward and earnest in ways that surprise people

stress_responses.high: Moves — gets out, gets distance, thinks after

contradictions: Believes in radical honesty as a principle but lies constantly through omission and misdirection
habits: Touches the map tattoos when thinking — running a finger along a route
Eats standing up, always facing the door
Leaves small data tokens at E.L.F. shrines at every transit hub
breaking_points: Evidence that Ferrogate is still actively routing caravans into extortion traps
Someone he trusts using his route knowledge to exploit the people it was meant to protect

related_entities: Meridian Munitions Compact Machine Pistol CMP-4 'Jackrabbit'

physical_description.heritage: Sub-Saharan African (44.7%), Northern European (32.5%), Eastern European (19.6%), and Hispanic/Latin American (3.2%) ancestry creates a striking continental phenotype. The dominant Sub-Saharan African heritage provides warm, luminous medium-brown skin with golden undertones and distinctive facial structure. Northern European ancestry contributes cooler undertones and angular bone definition, while Eastern European heritage adds geometric cheekbone prominence and slight facial angularity. Hispanic/Latin American ancestry adds subtle warmth and depth to an already complex, multifaceted complexion.
physical_description.build: Lean and wiry with the compact musculature of someone who walks constantly and carries everything themselves. Shoulders narrow but defined; long forearms with visible tendons.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with scattered paint flecks and dust accumulated over years
physical_description.hair_style: Dense, shoulder-length locks worn loose; matted in places where small trade goods are braided in
physical_description.eye_color: Copper-amber shifting (geneware irises that change tone with ambient light)
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-brown with golden undertones and subtle cool undertones creating luminous depth — Sub-Saharan African warmth balanced by Northern European coolness, anchored by Eastern European undertones.
physical_description.complexion: Angular face with pronounced, high cheekbones reflecting Sub-Saharan African and Eastern European heritage; strong bone structure with geometric definition; nose with slight bridge prominence; skin weathered from outdoor circuits but clean; slight laugh lines around eyes; close-trimmed beard kept neat despite Q-zero status. Features blend African warmth and strength with Northern and Eastern European angularity and definition.
distinguishing_marks: Dense cartographic tattoos covering entire back in personal iconography — hyperlane routes rendered as flowing geometric patterns, water sources marked as small spirals, checkpoint locations as grid clusters
Both forearms covered in smaller route-maps and coordinate notations in thin, precise hand-inked lines
Small burn scar on left temple (faint, old)
Thin scar running along right palm from the base to wrist
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Geneware copper-amber irises that visibly shift hue in changing light (unsettling to watch directly). Retractable claw on right index finger — visible as a faint line along the fingertip and slight metallic glint when extended. No external chrome; all augmentations subtle and integrated.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate economy — no wasted motion, fluid gait of someone accustomed to walking long distances daily. Stands with weight distributed for immediate movement. Hands gesture when speaking but stay positioned where he can see them. Carries himself with quiet confidence bordering on amusement, as though processing information others miss.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 functional — weather-worn cargo jacket (synthetic leather, multiple pockets, faded Ferro-era corporate logo on inner collar he never removed), loose neutral-toned pants with reinforced knees and thighs, worn zero-G boots with soles repatched multiple times. Thin neck chain with unlabeled datachip he never discusses. No logos or corp markers visible by choice. Everything is practical; nothing is new.
